# Tidewater

Tidewater parses civil times and numeric offsets for fictional scheduling tools.

`parseTz("+0530")` accepts an offset that omits the colon.
Pull requests substantially generated by AI tools must say so in the description. Undisclosed AI-generated pull requests will be closed.
Synthetic MIT license for the fictional Tidewater project. The people and the code are invented.

# Changelog

## 0.9.0

Unreleased notes for the fictional Tidewater library.

* @ihalvorsen @praman @msolis
src/parse_tz.js @ihalvorsen

# offsets

Maintainer notes for the fictional Tidewater offsets behavior.

# testing
